courses.title: Risk Management for Senior Finance Roles
courses.description: Risk Management for Senior Finance Roles focuses on risk management for people working toward a Senior Finance Manager role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces regulatory compliance, enough to apply alongside risk management in real Senior Finance Manager work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to risk management and show how regulatory compliance supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying risk management to a real Senior Finance Manager scenario
Practicing risk management through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to regulatory compliance
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Financial Reporting Standards
courses.description: Applying Financial Reporting Standards goes beyond the basics of financial reporting standards, for people already working toward a Senior Finance Manager role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in financial reporting standards and want to go further.

courses.description: Getting Started with Cost Management walks you through the basics of cost management, built for people new to Senior Finance Manager work. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
